verdict.rationale: Docs mention an 'AI chat' feature tied to PR review (e.g., 'Add to AI chat' to ask about selected code with diff/codebase context, or 'tour this PR' via chat), suggesting some chat-based contextual help exists, but it's framed around code review workflows rather than a general-purpose in-IDE coding assistant chat, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of this chat experience. Missing for 10: evidence of a full conversational assistant for general coding tasks (not just review), IDE-specific UI details, and community corroboration of the chat feature's usefulness.
